scenes.headline: How to carve a dense model into experts
scenes.sub: Whittle MoE 27B: a dense Qwen3.8-27B, split into 64 experts per layer.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Alder! Whittle MoE takes a dense twenty-seven billion parameter Qwen model, and cuts every feed-forward layer into experts.

scenes.text: Don't train a mixture of experts: re-index a dense model's feed-forward neurons into experts and add only routers. The carve is lossless in weight space.
scenes.say: The idea: re-index a dense model's feed-forward neurons into experts, and add only routers. The carve itself is lossless.

scenes.title: One feed-forward layer, re-indexed
scenes.say: Here's the arithmetic, for every one of sixty-four layers.

parts.note: neurons in the parent's dense feed-forward layer
parts.say: The parent's feed-forward layer is seventeen thousand four hundred and eight neurons wide.

parts.note: the hottest neurons, as one always-on shared expert
parts.say: The five thousand one hundred and twenty hottest become a shared expert that always runs.

parts.note: the rest, k-means clustered into 64 experts of 192
parts.say: The rest are clustered by k-means into sixty-four experts of a hundred and ninety-two neurons each.

scenes.title: One token through a carved layer

steps.say: Every token goes through the shared expert, no matter what.
A router, born as the k-means cluster centroids, picks sixteen of the sixty-four routed experts.

steps.note: 66.3% of the model is active per token
steps.say: Their outputs are averaged by router weight and added to the shared expert's. Sixty-six point three percent of the model still runs per token.

scenes.title: The fold that breaks a fresh carve

left.title: A dense layer
left.say: A dense layer sums its neurons. The carved one averages its sixteen picks, so the build multiplies each by sixteen.

right.title: The carved layer
items: Averages its top 16 by router weight
Exact only when all weights are equal
right.say: That is exact only when the router's weights are all equal, which a softmax never gives. So a fresh carve starts with a scale error.

scenes.label: mean angle the routers moved from their k-means starting point
scenes.note: routers were 6.2% of what the healing adapter trained
scenes.say: The card says only the routers were trained. They moved four point five degrees from their starting centroids. Most likely, the rest of the adapter did the work.

scenes.text: Splitting the weights losslessly isn't splitting the function losslessly. The sum-to-average fold breaks the model before routing even matters.

recap: A router born from k-means centroids
The average-for-sum fold is exact only when uniform
scenes.say: To recap: one shared expert, sixty-four routed ones, and a fold that holds only at uniform weights.
